notes: Credit and a spawn, and no start or finish, on purpose (gb-maps-1): an adventure climb map whose progress is buttons, levers, timed doors and a minecart (16 buttons, 13 func_wall_toggle, 12 logic_timer), with 79 joke-named destinations and no labelled start or finish. Its players spawn over an intro room and drop 800 units into it; the button there (finbut1) triggers `mapstartodesu`, which opens the room and 25 s later enables the teleport to `map0stato`, the start of the map proper. This game runs none of that, so the spawn is where `map0stato` leads (2026-10-11): `map0stato` itself is a sealed black box (cs_italy/black walls, an unlit ceiling) whose floor teleports to `stato` (until 2026-10-11 the importer made that floor send back to the spawn and held every player in the dark box), and `stato` is the top of a 46-degree chute the player slides 920 units down into the first corridor. The spawn is the foot of the chute, where the original puts a player a second after `map0stato`: measured by sliding a player down it here, at rest at 1840 4144 256. Nothing in the file marks where the map ends, and a finish line guessed from the logic is a board measuring a route the map does not have. Loads, draws and collides; zones want drawing in-game with the zone editor. Not published.

zones.note: the foot of the chute under `stato`, which `map0stato` teleports to: see notes
